why: One level, R 16, origin 0, voxel 0.25 m. Texels are filled analytically from a plane at z 2.0 m: a = |z_centre - 2.0| metres, rgb (1, 0.5, 0.25) where a <= 3 voxels, else 0. Ray hits are derived by hand from the step rule max(d - 0.5 voxel, 0.6 voxel) and the hit test d < 0.85 voxel while approaching.

rays.name: toward the plane
rays.why: t 0.25 samples d 1.25 (z 0.75, no approach yet) and steps 1.125 to t 1.375 (z 1.875), where d 0.125 < 0.2125 while approaching: the hit lies in [1.25, 1.5)

rays.name: away from the plane
rays.why: z 0.25 is local 1.0 voxel, outside the (1.5, R - 1.5) window, so the level lookup leaves the volume at once

lookup.why: the edge point sits 1 voxel inside x = 0 (local 1.0 < 1.5), so it answers levels.len() = 1
